verdict.rationale: Better Stack is a SaaS observability platform with AI features (AI SRE, a choice of third-party LLMs, an MCP server), so a buyer could fairly ask whether their telemetry is used for AI model training. However, the evidence pack has no AI-training opt-out, no data-usage policy, and no no-training commitment. Model selection and the requirement to approve automated actions are different features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
